claim: Parent-child chunking (200/700 chars) + bge-base-en-v1.5 + bge-reranker-v2-m3; public-data side channel (Oscar/MovieLens/Grammy/US stocks serialized to NL); regularized API wrapper get_movie(name,condition)[key] with eq/neq/ge/le/sort/AVG; SFT labels built by a 3-step relabeling pipeline that maps unanswerable-by-context questions to 'i don't know'. Scores 28.4/42.7/47.8.
counter: Author's own limitation: hand-written parser 'may affect the generalization capability'; general API selection unsolved. Organizer credits its win on Task2/3 specifically to the regularized-API work, not retrieval.
verdict_what: 抄两段：①正则化 API 封装（把官方 API 包成带 condition/key_name 的一层），②三段式 SFT 标签构造（basic 跑批 -> GPT-4 判对错 -> context 判可推 -> 不可推标 i don't know）。这两段都不需要大算力。

claim: Domain Router + Dynamism Router (Llama3-8B + MLP head + LoRA); Newspaper HTML parsing; Task3 BM25 pre-rank top-50 chunks(1024 tok) then bge-m3 256-tok chunks + bge-m3-v2-reranker top-5; step-wise KG pipeline (NER -> entity match -> time extraction -> hand rules -> JSON to Markdown); per-domain source trimming (sports/finance API-only); post-hoc 'i don't know' rules for real-time questions and numeric questions.
counter: Ablation shows KG-side components dominate: w/o EntityMatch -9.78, w/o TimeInfoExtract -12.77, but w/o Rerank only -2.05. The paper text also self-contradicts on whether pre-rank/rerank help ('marginally reduce' vs 'significantly contribute'); use the table.
verdict_what: 抄两件：①Dynamism Router 这一分类维度（比起 domain，动态性更能决定该不该答），②按域裁剪数据源的规则（实时域只走 API）。不抄手写 API 选择规则（db3 的正则化 API 是它的更优替代）。

rank: 3rd Task1; 1st in 5 of 7 question types of Task2
claim: Six modules: trafilatura text + separate markdown table extraction, attribute predictor (static/dynamic), numerical calculator (LLM emits a Python expression, executed externally), LLM knowledge extractor (answers from parametric memory first), KG function-calling module, reasoning module that re-judges everything. CoT forces three self-questions (false premise? answerable from refs? answerable from own knowledge?) inside a hard ===START===/===END=== frame.
counter: The gradient ablation is the real evidence: after swapping to Llama3-70B-GPTQ (-52.6 -> -0.3), every remaining point (+14 total) comes from refusal/self-check/tool modules, none from the retriever.
verdict_what: 抄两段：①表格单独抽成 Markdown 再喂（正文与表格分路），②数值计算委托外部 Python 执行器（不让 LLM 自己算）。三段式自问 CoT 可作拒答提示词模板。

claim: HTML-tree BFS chunking (node + descendants < 2000 chars = one segment); cross-encoder (ms-marco-MiniLM-L-6-v2) beat TF-IDF/biencoder/ensemble; per-task LoRA adapters on one resident Llama-3-8B; relabeled training targets where retrieval could not support the answer.
counter: Its own table is the strongest counter to 'more finetuning = better': LoRA with original labels raised accuracy 0.328->0.398 but hallucination 0.444->0.602 and CRAG score -0.116->-0.204; relabeled LoRA dropped accuracy to 0.242 but hallucination to 0.056 and score to +0.186. Also self-reports catastrophic forgetting.
verdict_what: 抄「检索不到就重标成 i don't know」这一条训练数据构造法（CRAG 分 -0.204 -> +0.186），以及 HTML 结构感知分块（按节点边界切，不按字符切）。注意副作用：灾难性遗忘。

rank: 1st in comparison type on all 3 tasks; 2nd Task1; 3rd Task2&3
claim: Per official spotlight: retrieval gating (skip retrieval when LLM self-confidence is high) + post-generation verification via self-consistency + fine-tuned LLaMA variants; three-step framework with answer-option re-judging.
counter: Could not read the technical report itself — OpenReview PDF blocked by Cloudflare (403 / human check on both openreview.net/pdf and api2.openreview.net). Everything above is second-hand from the organizer's spotlight post.
verdict_what: 拿到报告全文之前不给技术结论。仅记两个可复用的思路名：检索门控、生成后自一致性验证。

claim: Only the final score (25.6%) and placement are public; no technical report or repo found.
counter: 未搜到任何技术文档；组织者 spotlight 只覆盖 db3 / dRAGonRAnGers / md_dh。
verdict_what: 无方法可抄；仅作为榜单分距参照（与第 2 名差 19.3 个点，是全表最大断层）。

claim: 8-class domain router (Llama3.2-VL, 91.17% val); Grounding-DINO crops the query object before CLIP retrieval + VLM image-image same-entity rerank; merged text query rewrite (image info folded into a self-sufficient text query); bge-large-en-v1.5 + BGE-reranker-v2-m3; refusal trained with SFT -> DPO -> GRPO (reward +k/0/-1), DPO and GRPO checkpoints ensembled per domain; multi-turn uses last-step context only.
counter: Author admits the checkpoint ensemble 'shows huge improvements locally, while it turns out to be heavily overfitting' online; RL for query rewrite failed to beat SFT (DPO/GRPO both worse); OCR was dropped (VLM OCR too many tokens, PaddleOCR poor on egocentric images).
verdict_what: 抄两段：①merged query rewrite（把图片信息写进 query 再检索）——该项值 33%->44~46%；②拒答奖励设计 reward(+k 对 / 0 不知道 / -1 错)，k=1 时期望回报恰等于赛事评分。不抄 checkpoint ensemble（作者自认过拟合）。

claim: Llama3.2-11B-Vision + LoRA; SFT data distilled from GPT-4.1 (answerable? -> CoT + answer, else explicit refusal + reason, forced <think>/<answer> format); GRPO with curriculum learning over easy/hard split; retrieval = bge-large-en-v1.5 + BM25 + TF-IDF coarse then bge-reranker-v2-m3 top-5; image search abandoned as net-negative.
counter: Its own ablation exposes the trap: RL without curriculum collapses accuracy 0.262 -> 0.059 and pushes missing to 0.909 ('reward black hole'), only turning the score positive (+0.027) by refusing almost everything. Curriculum is the load-bearing part, not RL.
verdict_what: 抄课程学习三阶段（纯 easy -> 1:1 -> 1:2 真实分布）作为「让模型学会拒答又不弃答」的解法；抄 GPT-4.1 带标准答案生成「可答性判断 + CoT + 明确拒绝理由」的蒸馏方式。不抄其 RAG 管线（与常规三路融合无异）。

claim: One Llama-3.2-11B-Vision fine-tuned multi-task to serve as query rewriter + reranker + VQA (three tasks concatenated into one SFT dataset, 8xA100, 1.5h); publishes the finetuned model, the SFT datamix and the images; uses NVIDIA RAGAS as a local evaluator aligned to the online judge.
counter: The 'first-token probability > threshold -> force I don't know' trick appears only in a third-party Japanese blog (NTT docomo, 2025-12-17), not in the repo README — unverified.
verdict_what: 抄两段：①用同一个 VLM 兼做查询改写/重排/VQA 的多任务微调（省一个模型、省延迟）；②用 RAGAS 搭本地评测并与线上人工评分对齐后再调参——这一步决定了能不能在离线挑检查点。

claim: Training-free four-stage framework: lightweight query router (decide if external retrieval is needed) -> query-aware retrieval and summarization -> dual-path generation (RAG-grounded path vs model-prior path) -> verification and finalization with self-consistency plus structured Chain-of-Verification. Explicitly optimizes truthfulness over completeness.
counter: Only read the abstract and README; the arXiv HTML full text was not retrieved, so no ablation numbers are available. Placing 3rd with 6.7% is far from 1st (12.8%).
verdict_what: 抄「双路生成 + 交叉验证」这一结构（接地答案 vs 参数知识答案互校），以及「不需要训练也能上榜」这个前提判断——用于说服自己先做验证流程再谈训练。

claim: No external retrieval at all. Trains logistic-regression hallucination detectors on VLM hidden states and attention-head outputs (7 hidden states + 58 heads = 65 detectors, mean-ensembled), thresholds at 0.65 and forces 'I don't know'. Tried and rejected Answerability Check and logprob thresholds.
counter: Buys the score by destroying accuracy: single-turn accuracy 0.207 -> 0.082 (-61%) while hallucination 0.735 -> 0.045 (-94%), truthfulness -0.528 -> +0.036. This is a metric-satisfying extreme, not a usable system.
verdict_what: 方法本身不能抄（砍掉六成正确率换取不编）。但它是「拒答收益 >> 答对收益」这条评分性质的最强证明，可作为我们在自己评分体系里设定拒答阈值的参照系。
